$comment: Read and written by src/map_file.rs, whose tests check that the code and this schema agree.
title: Rust Pathfinder map
description: Terrain map written by File > Save and read by File > Load in Rust Pathfinder. The map is a rectangular grid stored row by row: the first row is the top of the map and each row lists its cells from left to right. The current version of Rust Pathfinder reads and writes 20 x 20 maps.

$schema.description: Optional URI of the schema this file conforms to, so editors can validate it. Rust Pathfinder writes the $id of this schema and ignores the value when loading.

formatVersion.description: Version of the map file format. It only changes when the format changes in a way that older versions of Rust Pathfinder cannot read.

rows.description: Number of rows in the grid. Must equal the number of rows in cells.

columns.description: Number of columns in the grid. Must equal the number of cells in every row of cells.

cells.description: Terrain of every cell, addressed as cells[row][column]. Row 0 is the top of the map and column 0 is its left edge.

row.description: One row of the grid, listing its cells from left to right.

cell.description: Terrain of one cell: "free" is open ground, "obstacle" is blocked ground and "unknown" has not been mapped yet.
